:::{#def-uniform-set}
#### Uniform distribution on a set

Let $S$ be a set with a
[measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#def-measure) $\measure$
such that $0 < \measure(S) < \infty$.
The **uniform distribution** on $S$ is the
[probability measure](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability)

$$\Pr(A) \eqdef \frac{\measure(A)}{\measure(S)}, \quad A \subseteq S.$$

:::
